name: Coherence
description: Measures how logically consistent and understandable the continuation is within the context of the original conversation.

name: Relevance
description: Assesses how closely the response aligns with the topic and context of the original dialogue and the interesting fact provided.

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the uniqueness and originality of the response compared to typical conversational continuations.
scale: Low Creativity, Moderate Creativity, High Creativity

name: Engagement Level
description: Determines the extent to which the response invites further dialogue or interaction from the other party.
scale: Low Engagement, Moderate Engagement, High Engagement

name: Empathy
description: Measures the degree to which the response demonstrates an understanding of the emotions and perspectives of the other participant in the conversation.
scale: Low Empathy, Moderate Empathy, High Empathy

name: Clarity
description: Assesses how clearly the ideas are expressed in the continuation, allowing for easy understanding by the audience.
